summary: Verification passed for the build.sh web launcher and the AppForge quality-gate detector fix: shell syntax, executable bit, prepared-workspace smoke startup, backend tests, frontend typecheck/build, AppForge-native run_tests/run_build gates, and documentation trace checks all passed.

results.evidence: APPFORGE_SKIP_INSTALL=1 APPFORGE_SKIP_FRONTEND_BUILD=1 APPFORGE_WEB_PORT=8799 ./build.sh --smoke returned 0 with /api/health and / ready, then stopped web server pid 17492.
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q returned 0: 24 passed with one StarletteDeprecationWarning from FastAPI/TestClient.
.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_tools.py -q returned 0: 7 tests passed, including PATH-empty Python quality command detection.
npm --prefix frontend run typecheck returned 0 and ran vue-tsc --noEmit.
npm --prefix frontend run build returned 0; Vite transformed 32 modules and emitted index-Bto0ykgx.js plus index-C_67LZJ9.css with no tracked asset diff.
detect_quality_commands now returns tests [.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q] and build [.venv/bin/python -m build --no-isolation] by using sys.executable for Python commands.
.venv/bin/python -m appforge tool run run_tests --project . --input '{}' returned success with skipped=false and command .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q.

.venv/bin/python -m appforge tool run run_build --project . --input '{}' returned success with skipped=false and command .venv/bin/python -m build --no-isolation. Setuptools license deprecation warnings remain non-blocking.
rg found ./build.sh, --smoke, --no-open, APPFORGE_START_LLM_BRIDGE, APPFORGE_SKIP_LLM_BRIDGE, and appforge web --no-open-browser references in README.md, docs/WEB_APP.md, and CHANGELOG.md.

acceptance_results.evidence: build.sh exists, is executable, defaults to APPFORGE_WEB_HOST=127.0.0.1 and APPFORGE_WEB_PORT=8787, and build_web_command delegates normal mode to .venv/bin/appforge web with browser opening unless no-open is selected.

ensure_python_env implements uv sync --extra dev and python3 venv/pip fallback; ensure_frontend conditionally runs npm --prefix frontend install and npm --prefix frontend run build. Skip-mode smoke/check verified prepared workspace behavior.
--smoke passed on port 8799 with APPFORGE_SKIP_INSTALL=1 and APPFORGE_SKIP_FRONTEND_BUILD=1, probed /api/health and /, and cleaned up the launcher-owned web server PID.

Source inspection verifies APPFORGE_DRIVER pass-through and no forced llm-bridge default. APPFORGE_DRIVER=llm-bridge APPFORGE_SKIP_LLM_BRIDGE=1 --check passed during implementation, proving the bridge skip branch.
README.md promotes ./build.sh before manual source setup, docs/WEB_APP.md documents launcher smoke/no-open/check and bridge behavior, and CHANGELOG.md records the launcher.
Default bind remains 127.0.0.1; the launcher adds no deployment, public bind, destructive cleanup of unrelated processes, or credential collection.
bash -n build.sh and prepared-workspace ./build.sh --smoke both returned 0.
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q, npm --prefix frontend run typecheck, npm --prefix frontend run build, AppForge run_tests, and AppForge run_build all returned 0.
APPFORGE_SKIP_INSTALL=1 and APPFORGE_SKIP_FRONTEND_BUILD=1 were used successfully for check/smoke, and the script only runs npm install when frontend/node_modules is absent.
appforge/tooling/detection.py now uses sys.executable for Python quality commands, and tests/test_tools.py covers PATH-empty detection so AppForge complete can run required run_tests/run_build gates.

coverage: Verification covers requirements FR-001 through FR-005 and NFR-001 through NFR-004 plus the AppForge quality-gate regression discovered during verification. It maps to workflow steps WF-001 through WF-007, memory surfaces MEM-001 through MEM-007, and loop IDs LOOP-001 through LOOP-006 through syntax, prepared-workspace check/smoke, source inspection, docs grep, pytest, typecheck, production build, and AppForge-native gate evidence.
failures: A first sandboxed smoke attempt failed with operation not permitted while binding 127.0.0.1:8799; the approved local-bind rerun passed. This is recorded as an environment permission issue, not a product failure.

The first AppForge verification completion failed because quality_commands emitted python-based commands that were dropped when python was not on PATH. Fixed by using sys.executable for Python quality commands and adding a regression test; AppForge run_tests and run_build now pass with skipped=false.
First-run dependency downloads were not exercised because the AppForge runner has network downloads disabled; verification used the prepared workspace and skip flags as specified.
manual_checks: Reviewed build.sh for side-effect-free argument parsing before setup commands, finite smoke and bridge loops, and cleanup limited to captured WEB_PID/BRIDGE_PID.
Reviewed README.md and docs/WEB_APP.md to confirm the new launcher is documented as the easiest source UI path while existing appforge web and frontend development commands remain present.
Reviewed appforge/tooling/detection.py to confirm Python quality commands use the active interpreter and continue through the existing command policy.
